title: Frontend: Level-up celebration animation on points threshold crossed
description: Show a special level-up celebration toast/modal when the project crosses a level threshold.
acceptanceCriteria: Level-up modal or toast appears when project level increases
Shows the new level name and icon
Does not show on initial page load — only on actions that trigger level up

steps.details: Several API responses include level change data. When an action endpoint returns { didLevelUp: true, newLevel: 'Growing' } in the response, trigger the celebration.

Create src/components/LevelUpCelebration.tsx. A Dialog that auto-opens when triggered. Shows: '🎉 Level Up!', new level name, level description, and confetti animation via canvas-confetti. Dismiss on close or after 5 seconds.

steps.description: Wire into todo and milestone completion handlers
steps.details: In TodoItem completion handler and MilestoneItem completion handler: check response for didLevelUp. If true, set a Zustand store trigger or use a custom event to open the LevelUpCelebration.
Earn enough points to trigger level up. Verify modal appears with correct level name and confetti fires.
